A shadow box containing an evil eye (nazar), a corked herb vial, cinnamon stick, black stone, and a dried red pepper — traditional protection amulets drawn from multiple cultures, arranged on white salt.

The inscription reads: Fé / Oração / Proteção / Meu Amuleto / Meu Coração — “Faith / Prayer / Protection / My Amulet / My Heart.”

Quadraria e Poesia was born from the creative partnership of Guilherme Rueda, a poet who published his first poetry collection in 2020, and Rafael Daltôe, a visual artist and architect based in Jundiá, São Paulo. Every piece is 100% original and handcrafted, made one by one — poetry made into a physical object.

This piece was a gift from family, introducing the studio’s work and leading to a deeper connection with their practice.
